image_description: A high-angle view of a steep, sunlit cliff face composed of layered sedimentary rock. The rock exhibits vertical striations and weathering patterns, illuminated by warm, golden light from the upper left. At the base, dark green vegetation (trees/bushes) obscures part of the foot of the cliff, next to a body of water with a small structure or boat visible in the lower right corner.

The object in the water (possibly a boat or dock) lacks clear geometric definition. Its edges blend into the water texture ambiguously, suggesting potential AI difficulty in rendering complex rigid structures interacting with fluid surfaces.
